title: MusicDrop v1.4.7 Available
changelog:
• Audio-Video Lip-Sync Sync: Micro rate-steering synchronization automatically locks audio and video in sync without stutter or lag
• Redundant Video Download Engine: 3-tier fallback (NewPipe, P-Web, InnerTube direct) ensuring high-resolution MP4 video downloads never fail
• Song Options Bottom Sheet: Xiaomi-style quick action sheet with Set as ringtone, Change cover art, Hide song, Delete, and queue actions
• Song Details & Tag Editor: View full audio metadata (format, bitrate, file path) and edit song title, artist, album, and cover art
